info.name: ReviewMind API
info.description:
ReviewMind - Semantic AI Code Reviewer.

Run the requests top to bottom; they tell the story of the project.

PREREQUISITES
  1. API server:  .venv/bin/uvicorn api.main:app --port 8000
  2. Shop service: cd experiments/corpus/shop && uvicorn service:app --port 9000 --reload

THE KEY COMPARISON is requests 4 and 5: the SAME code change reviewed
without and with repository context. Everything else supports that.

request.description: Confirms the API is running, which model is configured, and how many code chunks are indexed. Start here to prove the service is live.
Current state of the demo shop: is the checkout broken, and what is it charging for a Rs.1000 order? A broken checkout reports 20000.
Reintroduces the defect so the demonstration can be repeated. After this, request 2 reports 'broken' and the shop page charges Rs.20,000.

Reviews the change with the AI seeing ONLY the diff.

Expect a plausible but WRONG diagnosis - it has no way to know what discount_percent returns, because that lives in another file.

body.raw:
{
  "diff": "diff --git a/experiments/corpus/shop/service.py b/experiments/corpus/shop/service.py
index 6e64013..25d0788 100644
--- a/experiments/corpus/shop/service.py
+++ b/experiments/corpus/shop/service.py
@@ -56,7 +56,7 @@ def shop(customer: int = 101, amount: float = 1000.0):
 
     tier = record["tier"]
     percent = discount_percent(tier)
-    payable = apply_discount(amount, tier)
+    payable = amount * percent
 
     return HTMLResponse(storefront.render(
         name=record["name"], tier=tier, discount=percent,
",
  "use_retrieval": false,
  "changed_file": "service.py"
}

request.description:
The SAME change, SAME model, SAME prompt - but the reviewer may first fetch related code from the repository.

request.description: The RAG question-answering bot over the same codebase. Answers are grounded in retrieved code and cite their sources.

item.name: 8. Review a live GitHub pull request

request.description: Fetches a real pull request from GitHub, reviews it, and posts inline comments back to it. Set post=false to review without commenting.
Asks the model to WRITE a fix and applies it to the service. The fix is generated each time, not replayed from a stored copy. Afterwards, request 2 reports 'working' and the shop charges Rs.800.
